SETUP_TOKEN.description: Opens the setup screen at `/setup`, where you create the first Owner. Use 32 random characters or more. To make one, run `openssl rand -base64 32`. Keep it for the setup screen. See [the setup guide](https://github.com/me-shaon/plainbooks/blob/main/docs/setup.md).

AUTH_SECRET.description: Signs the sign-in sessions. Use 32 random characters or more. To make one, run `openssl rand -base64 32`. A new value later signs everyone out.

ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Encrypts the email provider keys that you save in Settings. Use 32 random bytes as base64. To make one, run `openssl rand -base64 32`. A new value later means you must enter the provider keys again.

APP_URL.description: Public origin of the app, for example `https://invoices.example.com`. No trailing slash.

GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID.description: Optional. The client ID of your Google OAuth client. Google sign-in shows only when this value and `GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET` are set. See [the setup guide](https://github.com/me-shaon/plainbooks/blob/main/docs/setup.md#7-optional-turn-on-google-sign-in).

GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Optional. The client secret of your Google OAuth client.

scripts.e2e:db: rm -rf .wrangler/e2e && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --persist-to .wrangler/e2e/main && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --persist-to .wrangler/e2e/auth
scripts.deploy: pnpm run build && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy
